answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The dune cap is policed at intake and sparrow reveals the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a pulse tag. The deposit is 76 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
